title: 缓存怎样处理一次请求

passages.en: A cache keeps recently used results. A cache hit reuses a stored value; a cache miss requires loading it again.
passages.zh: 缓存保存最近使用过的结果，缓存命中时直接复用已有值，缓存未命中时需要重新读取

sentences.en: A cache keeps recently used results. A cache hit reuses a stored value; a cache miss requires loading it again.
sentences.zh: 缓存保存最近使用过的结果，缓存命中时直接复用已有值，缓存未命中时需要重新读取

passages.en: The cache uses a dictionary to find nodes by key and a doubly linked list to record recent use. On a hit, get(key) moves the node to the front; on a miss it returns None. put(key,value) updates or creates a node. If capacity is exceeded, it removes the last node and deletes its key from the dictionary.
passages.zh: 缓存用一个字典保存键到节点的对应，用双向链表记录最近使用顺序。get(key) 在命中时把节点移到链表头，未命中返回 None；put(key,value) 更新或创建节点，容量超限时移除尾节点，同时从字典删除。
